hints.title: Adjacent Boundary Chaining
hints.text: In a circular sentence, the last character of each word must equal the first character of the next word.

hints.title: Wraparound Condition
hints.text: The last character of the final word must equal the first character of the very first word.

hints.title: Single Space Separation
hints.text: Whenever a space occurs at index i, sentence[i - 1] must match sentence[i + 1].

hints.title: Direct Boundary Match Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass checking space boundaries without string tokenization.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Splitting full string into word arrays creates unnecessary heap allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Validates cyclic character equality across spaces in linear time.
